outcomeFirst: The measured expensive seam is already one PowerShell process containing both ordered queries. Merely combining process and listener acquisition again cannot remove the observed cost.
No inspected existing native witness, broker operation, controller or build target supplies the required complete process rows plus every owner of the selected listening port.

A potentially preserving candidate is one controller-owned persistent PowerShell interpreter used only as a transport for the unchanged process-then-listener query. Every existing synchronous guard would still submit and wait for a fresh request.

This is not a ready replacement: synchronous integration, request completion semantics, bounded framing and original child cleanup must be implemented and proved. A Promise or an early JSON line would weaken current authority.
The possible saving is repeated interpreter startup. The evidence does not measure that component or establish that the remaining original Retry work would fit within ten seconds.

exactObservationContract.processQuery: @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Property ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CreationDate,ExecutablePath | Where-Object CreationDate | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{pid=[int]$_.ProcessId; parent=[int]$_.ParentProcessId; birth=$_.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); executable=$_.ExecutablePath} }) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rawProcessFields.required: All original eligible rows, not only owned/selected PIDs.
Retain the full parent relationship used by controller-driver and lineage/orphan checks.
Preserve the exact original UTC round-trip string/precision. Do not replace it with PID-only identity or lossy Date parsing.
Preserve the original optional/falsy-path behavior; do not omit inaccessible rows merely to manufacture complete paths.

exactObservationContract.universeQualification: The existing query already filters rows lacking CreationDate. 'Full' means that exact original eligible universe, including foreign processes, with no new PID/owner/process-name restriction.
exactObservationContract.listenerContract: MSFT_NetTCPConnection in Root\StandardCimv2, LocalPort=9222 for this gate and State=2. No LocalAddress/address-family filter: preserve all returned IPv4 and IPv6 owners, including foreign owners. Original parser requires positive integer PIDs and deduplicates by first occurrence.
exactObservationContract.ordering: Finish the current full process acquisition first, then acquire listeners. It is a fresh ordered pair, not an atomic snapshot; the candidate must not claim atomicity.
exactObservationContract.errorSemantics: A successful empty listener result is distinct from provider/access/namespace/query failure. Any failed query, incomplete envelope or executor error refuses the whole observation. No partial stdout recovery, retry, fallback or stale last-success result.
exactObservationContract.authorityAfterParse: Keep validateCensus and all current sameIdentity, controller-parent, Main lineage, orphan/overflow, all-listener PID/birth ownership and post-read deadline checks literal in behavior.

alternatives.finding: query-wait-gated retains one selected PID/birth HANDLE witness; broker service operations act on selected captures; controller membership covers its Job. None supplies the complete Win32_Process rows and selected-port/all-owner listener set.
alternatives.prohibition: Do not reinterpret a held HANDLE or zero Job count as the omitted full process/listener observation.

alternatives.option: Owned persistent PowerShell with a synchronous worker bridge
alternatives.status: CONCRETE DESIGN CANDIDATE ONLY; not selected, authored, executed or performance-qualified
alternatives.preservationMechanism: Retain the exact current CIM query bodies and parsers. Change only how the already-combined query is delivered: one new request at each original paired-snapshot call, processed by one owned interpreter. Keep other exported process/listener/default one-shot functions unchanged.
alternatives.boundedScope: The ten paired calls in this observed Retry could avoid ten repeated interpreter starts after one initial startup. The process-only host census remains unchanged. Future call counts remain controlled by the original code and predicates, not by imposing a new fixed 11-call cap.
alternatives.syncBridge: Existing shared UI controls invoke assertOwnedRenderer(): void synchronously. A same-file Node worker may own the interpreter and drain its pipes while the main thread waits on a finite SharedArrayBuffer/Atomics reply. No caller may continue with a Promise or merely queued work.
alternatives.requests: One in-flight request, per-instance identity plus strictly increasing safe-integer sequence, a closed observation operation and validated selected port. No arbitrary script/command input, no background preread, prefetch, cache, TTL, coalescing, replay or automatic child restart.
alternatives.completionBarrier: The old executor returns only after the child has completed with no exec error/nonzero exit. A persistent process cannot use a per-request process exit. Its closed loop must emit a distinct correlated completion record only after both queries and serialization have succeeded, with a failure latch for every exception. A complete-looking data line followed by a query error must not be admitted.
alternatives.frameAndMemory: Bound raw query output and errors consistently with the current 1 MiB synchronous-process limit, then separately bound protocol framing/shared memory. Validate instance, request, operation, status, length, encoding and terminal marker before exposing the unchanged parser input. Partial, duplicate, stale, reordered or trailing frames and overflow are failures; never empty-success.
alternatives.clock: Retain the original 30-second query-executor maximum and all original phase/outer pre- and post-read checks without increasing any budget. The bridge must have a finite validated wait; undefined/NaN cannot become an infinite Atomics wait. Initialization and shutdown consume existing outer/controller allowance, and any setup phase timing must remain inside the existing phase rules.
alternatives.workerSafety: Use a fixed audited same-file worker role and explicit empty execArgv to avoid inherited TS/preload recursion. Preserve the parent's exact intended PowerShell executable/environment/cwd; do not share mutable env or log its values. Worker-side pipe draining and shared-memory completion must not depend on blocked parent stdio.
alternatives.normalCleanup: Retain the original child object and pipe ownership and preserve controller confinement. If a helper PID/birth/path join is needed, derive it from an existing fresh full census; never add PID-only authority or replace the original census. Include the observer naturally in the complete process universe, not in a filtered-out special category. It is a driver child, not a Main descendant. Actual descendant confinement remains an implementation/qualification obligation, not a proved new observation here.
alternatives.failureCleanup: Close once after the last use within the existing ordinary finally allowance, drain bounded tails, and require the original child terminal/pipe completion plus worker exit before qualification. A worker exit/terminate/unref alone does not prove its OS child absent. If custody is lost, refusal/emergency controller containment remains FAIL. Do not signal by a recycled PID, hide a cleanup error, replace the primary error, reset a deadline or relaunch the observer.
alternatives.rawEvidence: Preserve existing censusReads timing/result/truncation records and all source/input/phase/cleanup evidence. Any new transport lifecycle fields must report only observed bounded state, not convert receipt counters or successful parsing into OS absence.
alternatives.unproved: This source analysis establishes an API route for a synchronous bridge, not a completed protocol implementation, actual child containment proof, native field equivalence test or speedup. Those concrete implementation details do not yet exist.

alternatives.option: New native full-process plus TCP-table collector
alternatives.finding: Direct native enumeration could avoid the interpreter, but no such complete collector is present in the inspected sources. A selected-HANDLE helper is insufficient.
alternatives.missingEvidence: A concrete API/source implementation would need proof of the exact original row universe, creation-time precision/timezone, parent identity, optional path/access behavior, IPv4+IPv6 all-owner listener coverage, success-empty versus provider/query errors, completeness/overflow and ordered acquisition. No Toolhelp/WMI/extended-TCP-table replacement has been authored or audited here.
alternatives.scopeLimit: No native target, controller protocol, CMake entry or extra file is proposed for selection by this advisory.

prospectiveFileBoundary.possibleChange: A fixed same-file worker/closed observation transport and explicit owned factory, preserving all existing default exported functions and original parsers/query text. No target API exports or production provider changes.

Own one observer lifecycle and pass its synchronous executor into only the existing paired-snapshot seam; retain all business/click/Retry/row/census/cleanup checks and clocks. Explicit helper cleanup must join the final qualification.
Preserve the whole existing 14-case prefix and append actual transport/guard/lifecycle regressions if the root selects this design. New case count and exact postimage are not chosen.

unchangedBoundary.frozen: Shared controls and whole 149/43/85 remain unchanged. The 8-case native UI test file can remain exact; it has only 55 lines of headroom under the original 800 cap.
unchangedBoundary.build: The described same-file built-in worker design needs no new package, dependency, native binary or CMake/workflow change. Actual candidate line counts and source freeze coverage remain to be checked if authored; fit is not claimed.
unchangedBoundary.testsRoute: The already accepted native-receipt whole-file import covers the existing platform test module through the current static entry. This advisory neither changes a workflow nor selects a new CI venue. It does not claim these hypothetical new tests have run.
notAllowed: No repeated/batched reuse of a prior observation
No omission of the process-only census or any of seven click guards
No coalescing currentness checks across awaits
No delayed or shortened assertion list

meaningfulRegressionRequirementsIfSelect.proof: Exercise the actual new transport/paired function with two successive different full snapshots. Assert exact current query text, one fresh process-then-listener execution per call, unchanged parsers, no reuse or prefetch.

Retain parent and high-precision birth strings, optional paths, foreign processes/orphans, PID reuse, multiple/duplicate/foreign selected-port owners and both-family fixtures. Successful empty listener output remains a valid data result that the ownership guard later refuses.

The actual loop must refuse a complete-looking payload followed by a query error, mid-frame EOF, nonzero child completion, failure before/after data, malformed/stale/reordered/duplicate IDs, unknown status, trailing output, byte overflow and timeout. No retry or previous-success fallback.

Use the actual executor and existing source-slice gate harness: no downstream DOM evaluation/input can run while the correlated observation is pending; the guard returns only after complete proof or throws. A Promise-returning counterfactual must fail.
A late completed observation cannot pass the existing post-read remaining check. Invalid wait values cannot become infinite waits. No test replaces or extends the original production deadline.

Exercise actual finite owned-child/worker closure, EOF/tail handling and first-error preservation. A worker-only exit, lost child terminal status, close failure, timeout or forced containment cannot qualify cleanup. One close attempt/no automatic restart.

Preserve all current native UI cases and complete platform prefix. Future real Windows x64/ARM packaged execution of the unchanged original flow is the only evidence that the concrete implementation preserves actual CIM/Job behavior and completes Retry within the existing ten seconds; mock/protocol tests alone do not establish it.

limits.currentEvidence: Prior failure receipt and current source establish expensive repeated observation calls and the exact refusal boundary. They do not identify a faulty Windows provider, a specific OS call causing delay, or a guaranteed speedup.
limits.synchronousRisk: The main thread blocks today and would block on a preserving synchronous bridge. Callback-only timeout/error delivery cannot protect that blocked interval; finite shared-state completion/expiry and final original clock checks are necessary.
limits.processCompletionRisk: Persistent transport changes the completion witness from child exit per request to a protocol barrier. Preserving error semantics is a concrete implementation burden, not an assumption or a proved property of this report.
limits.helperCustodyRisk: Keeping an observer alive adds a controlled process lifetime. Its original child/stream closure and controller containment must be demonstrated by the actual future implementation; existing app cleanup alone does not prove helper cleanup.
limits.timingRisk: Even eliminating all repeated startup cost may be insufficient because the original unfinished Retry work is unmeasured. No expected-millisecond saving or sub-ten-second claim is made.
limits.taskCompletion: A source-supported candidate and exact missing proof are supplied. No executable repair, fix selection, new gate or runtime qualification is supplied.
